evals.prompt: Design an ETL pipeline to ingest student activity logs from 3 sources: a PostgreSQL database (batch), a Kafka stream (real-time), and CSV exports from partner schools (daily). Target is a Snowflake data warehouse.
evals.expected_output: Proposes hybrid ETL/ELT architecture, defines ingestion strategy per source, includes data quality gates, schema evolution handling, and orchestration with Airflow.
assertions: Designs different ingestion strategies for each of the 3 source types
Includes data quality validation gates between ingestion and loading stages
Proposes orchestration with Airflow or equivalent with retry and monitoring

evals.prompt: Our dbt models are taking 45 minutes to run. The bottleneck is 3 models that join 5 large tables (10M+ rows each) with no incremental strategy. All models run as full refreshes nightly.
evals.expected_output: Recommends incremental models with merge strategy, partitioning, materialization optimization, and model dependency refactoring.
assertions: Recommends converting the bottleneck models to incremental materialization
Proposes partitioning or clustering strategies for the large join tables
Suggests model dependency refactoring to enable parallel execution

evals.prompt: We detected schema drift: the partner school CSV added 3 new columns last week and renamed 2 existing ones, which broke our pipeline. Design a schema evolution strategy.
evals.expected_output: Proposes schema contracts, automated drift detection, backward-compatible evolution rules, alerting, and a schema registry approach.
assertions: Proposes a schema contract or data contract approach with partner schools
Designs automated schema drift detection with alerting before pipeline failure
Includes backward-compatible evolution rules for handling additions and renames

evals.prompt: Design a real-time streaming pipeline for student engagement analytics. Events include page views, quiz attempts, video watch time, and chat messages. We need sub-second aggregations for the live dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Proposes streaming architecture with Kafka/Flink or similar, defines windowing strategies, addresses exactly-once semantics and late-arriving events.
assertions: Proposes a streaming platform (Kafka + Flink, or equivalent) for sub-second processing
Defines windowing strategies (tumbling, sliding, session) for different aggregation needs
Addresses exactly-once semantics and handling of late-arriving events

evals.prompt: Implement data quality checks for our student records pipeline. Common issues: duplicate student IDs, null email addresses, enrollment dates in the future, and GPA values outside 0-4 range.
evals.expected_output: Proposes Great Expectations or dbt tests, defines specific expectations for each data quality issue, includes alerting and quarantine for failed records.
assertions: Recommends a data quality framework like Great Expectations or dbt tests
Defines specific validation rules for each of the 4 identified quality issues
Includes a quarantine mechanism for failed records with alerting
